europe_now.title: EU moves to ease subsidy rules for small media
europe_now.summary: The European Union has announced plans to relax subsidy regulations for smaller media organizations to support independent journalism. This policy change aims to address funding challenges faced by regional and niche media outlets across the continent.

europe_now.title: EU backs top international court against onslaught from Trump and Rubio
europe_now.summary: The European Union has expressed strong support for the International Criminal Court following pressure from the United States and other critics. Member states have called for continued judicial independence despite external political pressures.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Appoints New Defence Minister Amid Political Changes
top_stories.summary: The Ukrainian parliament approved a new defence minister following a controversial reshuffle within the armed forces. This leadership transition occurs as the country continues its military operations against Russian forces.
